activate_when: A material change requires sequencing across multiple engineering units
Unknowns or dependencies make direct editing likely to create rework
Acceptance criteria need to trace into implementation and verification
capabilities.description: Build a proportionate, repository-aware implementation plan from acceptance criteria, sequencing the smallest safe change and its evidence without pretending uncertain file-level details are known.
capabilities.purpose: Plan the smallest safe repository-aware path from accepted outcome to verified implementation while preserving flexibility under new evidence.

activate_when: Material work in an unfamiliar existing repository
The responsible files or architecture boundary are not yet clear
Repository conventions should determine the implementation approach
capabilities.description: Map an unfamiliar or materially relevant existing repository before changing it, finding the smallest architecture, conventions, tests, and change surface needed for the task.
capabilities.purpose: Map the smallest relevant portion of an existing repository before material change, grounding implementation choices in actual project architecture and conventions.

activate_when: User intent is outcome-oriented but not yet testable
Material behavior has multiple plausible interpretations
Completion criteria must distinguish explicit requirements from engineering inferences
capabilities.description: Turn user intent and repository context into testable acceptance criteria, separating explicit requirements, justified engineering inferences, assumptions, and decisions that genuinely require the user.
capabilities.purpose: Turn user intent and project evidence into a scoped, observable acceptance contract without forcing users to specify inferable engineering details.

activate_when: A failure exists but its root cause is not established
Several plausible causes require evidence to discriminate
An intermittent or cross-layer defect needs a controlled diagnosis
capabilities.description: Diagnose non-obvious failures by reproducing the symptom, separating facts from hypotheses, narrowing the causal path with discriminating experiments, and fixing the smallest verified root cause.
capabilities.purpose: Diagnose non-obvious failures through causal evidence and discriminating experiments before applying the narrowest verified fix.

activate_when: Changing observable behavior where repository-native executable evidence can be written first
Preventing a regression with a focused behavioral test
capabilities.description: Establish executable behavioral evidence before fixing bugs or changing testable behavior, using the repository's existing test surfaces and proportionate RED-GREEN-refactor discipline rather than universal coverage or tooling rules.
capabilities.purpose: Establish executable evidence around defects and testable behavior changes using proportionate repository-native TDD rather than universal tooling or coverage rules.

activate_when: A material change appears complete and the completion claim needs evidence
The actual diff may have introduced verification obligations beyond the original plan
A distinction is needed between implemented, deployable, deployed, and post-deploy verified
capabilities.description: Verify that the evidence actually supports the completion claim before saying work is done. Use after implementation, debugging, refactoring, or any material change, and distinguish code-complete, deployable, deployed, and post-deploy-verified states.
capabilities.purpose: Ensure completion claims do not exceed actual evidence by verifying the changed behavior with proportionate repository-native checks and explicit claim boundaries.
